text: AUTHOR-GATE STOP: I created narrow docs commit 834f280 but the shared checkout was on main, so this bypassed the required candidate/review boundary and places the commit on main first-parent. No push and no further Git mutation. Proposed least-destructive repair, subject to chief authority: create a candidate branch at 834f280; compare-and-swap local main back to parent e584ad6; unstage only the reserved doc while keeping its working copy; then report the branch/SHA for review. No reset --hard, checkout, or unrelated path change.
